functions.normalizeCalendarEntry:
function normalizeCalendarEntry(entry){
  return{
    id:entry.id||makeId("calendar-entry"),
    title:entry.title||"Slot editorial",
    origin:entry.origin||"avulso",
    lineId:entry.lineId||"",
    number:entry.number||"",
    natures:Array.isArray(entry.natures)?entry.natures:(Array.isArray(entry.nature)?entry.nature:[]),
    date:entry.date||"",
    time:entry.time||"",
    behavior:entry.behavior==="parallel"?"parallel":"main",
    fixed:!!entry.fixed,
    priority:entry.priority||"normal",
    status:entry.status||"provisório",
    posted:!!entry.posted,
    postedAt:entry.postedAt||"",
    note:entry.note||"",
    link:entry.link||"",
    targetMonth:Number.isInteger(entry.targetMonth)?entry.targetMonth:null,
    holiday:!!entry.holiday,
    holidayName:entry.holidayName||"",
    holidayScope:entry.holidayScope||"",
    referenceDate:entry.referenceDate||"",
    operationDecision:entry.operationDecision||"",
    updatedAt:entry.updatedAt||nowIso()
  };
}
